title: COMEDK Results 2026 Out at comedk.org, Direct Link to Download UGET Rank Card, Merit List
fullContentHtml:
The Consortium of Medical, Engineering and Dental Colleges of Karnataka has announced the COMEDK Result 2026 on 29th May 2026 at its official website. The results have been declared in the form of an online rank card. All those candidates who appeared for the COMEDK exam can now check and download their results by simply logging in to the official website bpsc.bihar.gov.in and logging in using their respective login credentials that were generated at the time of registration. They can also access their online COMEDK UGET results by simply clicking on the direct link shared in the article below.

COMEDK Mock Test: Attempt Now

COMEDK Results 2026 OUT

The COMEDK Undergraduate Entrance Test 2026 is a state-level entrance test conducted by the Consortium of Medical, Engineering, and Dental Colleges of Karnataka to select eligible candidates to secure admission into undergraduate engineering and architecture courses (B.E., B.Tech, and B.Arch). The selection process consists of three main stages: the entrance examination, centralized online counseling (including document verification), and seat allotment. For the year 2026, the exam was successfully held on 09th May, after the exams, candidates were eagerly waiting for the announcement of their results. So this is to inform them that the COMEDK Result 2026 has been declared on 29th May 2026 at the official website, www.comedk.org.

COMEDK Results 2026 PDF Download Link

The official window to check and download the detailed COMEDK Result 2026 has been activated by the Consortium of Medical, Engineering, and Dental Colleges of Karnataka on its official website. The result PDF has all necessary details, such as the candidate’s personal information, scored marks, overall pass percentage, pass/fail status and much more. Candidates can check and download their online COMEDK Merit List 2026 either through the official website or by simply clicking on the direct link shared below.

How to Check COMEDK Rank Card 2026 at comedk.org?

All those candidates who appeared for the COMEDK recruitment examination can access their online rank card by visiting the official website and following the detailed step-by-step process shared below:

Step 1: Firstly go to the official Consortium of Medical, Engineering, and Dental Colleges of Karnataka website www.comedk.org.

Step 2: Click on the latest updated tab.

Step 3: Now search for the COMEDK Result 2026 PDF download link.

Step 4: Page with redirected to the login window.

Step 5: Carefully enter your respective application number, password/date of birth and security pin.

Step 6: Once the details are filled successfully, click on the ‘submit’ option.

Step 7: Check all the details mentioned on the COMEDK UGET rank cards.

Step 8: At the end, make sure you download and save your respective COMEDK Result 2026 PDF for future use.

What details are mentioned on the COMEDK Results 2026?

The online COMEDK result has all the important information, including the scored marks, pass/fail status and much more. Some of the details mentioned on the online rankcards have also been discussed here.

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Application Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Category
  • Guardian’s Name
  • Subjects applied for
  • Total marks
  • Percentage
  • COMEDK Cut-Off
  • Pass/Fail Status
  • Details Regarding the next stage

What’s Next After the COMEDDK UGET Results 2026?

After the announcement of the COMEDK UGET Results on 29th May 2026, all those candidates who have successfully qualified the entrance test can now apply for the second stage, which is the centralized online counseling (including document verification). For this stage candidates will be required to required to register themselves through the official COMEDK website and pay an application fee of 2000 rupees. It is to be noted that the admissions are purely merit-based, determined by your rank and the availability of seats across participating engineering and architecture colleges in Karnataka.
